entity: Nebraska air regulators: zero formal enforcement actions 2017-2025
why: The state's own enforcement pages show formal air consent orders inside our window: Green Plains Wood River 2022-02-16 and ADM 2025-10-22, both Clean Air Act. That contradicts the zero-actions claim, opposite direction, even though EPA's SRF (which matched) found no formal responses in its review period. The watch_out named this exact hole.
